Imyitozo ngororamubiri: Kuva ijanisha rirenga 92% byimyitozo ngororamubiri yarangiye, kuzenguruka bizarangira kandi ibirimo bizashimangirwa ninyigisho hamwe nakazi kiyongereye kugeza amasaha yose arangiye.
Raporo y'imyitozo izatangwa nta isuzuma rya nyuma ry’abarwayi kandi nta ruhushya rwabigenewe.
Ibipimo bya sisitemu no gusuzuma isomo: isuzuma rya nyuma rizaba rigizwe n'ibice bibiri:
Amanota yabarimu 50%.
50% Isuzuma rya raporo y'imyitozo.
